articleTitle: Internet of Things Online Laboratory: non-Virtual Training
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes a cyber-physical system located in the university laboratory. It allows students to study Internet of Things technologies remotely. The purpose of the system is to provide students with automated access to bench equipment and information services used in the field of IoT. The article presents functional and non-functional requirements for the system. The organization of bench equipment and the software structure of the developed cyberphysical system are described. Students can program microcontrollers remotely via a Web application. In addition, they can visually and programmatically monitor the state of the development board and launch IoT services. The Internet of Things online laboratory changes the organization and model of the educational process with real equipment. At the same time, the teacher can monitor the work of both online and offline students. Students have more opportunities to work with the equipment of the Internet of Things laboratory. The online laboratory is available not only during hours designated for practical classes, but also during additional hours. In this case, the presence of a laboratory assistant or teacher is not required in the physical laboratory. The work identified new opportunities and advantages of training using an online laboratory based on a cyber-physical system.

articleTitle: From Assembly Drawing to Virtual Model: Manufacturing Technologies in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The work demonstrates the possibilities of utilizing visualization of a digital model in the educational process of higher education in the training of engineers. As part of an educational design bureau, based on an assembly drawing, students need to develop an electronic model of a technical product, parameterize and visualize it, and prepare design documentation. The presentation of the project is carried out in a virtual reality system. Product design is carried out in T-FLEX CAD. This program is a professional design system for 2D and 3D modeling and is included in the package of the Russian PLM information system. Analysis of the content and effectiveness of educational activities on three-dimensional visualization of digital models, performed during group work, updates a number of traditional knowledge, skills and abilities for a qualified engineer. In the process of work, competencies of an advanced, innovative nature are also formed, related to both the professional and communicative spheres.

articleTitle: Information Technologies for Designing Professional Educational Programs of Engineering Training for Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this article the authors consider the problem of training qualified specialists to work in the digital economy at the current level of higher education development. The authors study the very concept of “competencies” and discuss the difficulties associated with the introduction of competency-based approach in the system of higher professional education. The article presents the main principles and definitions of the competency-based approach for the formation of educational outcomes within higher education. It is argued that an important aspect in the creation of educational programs is their orientation to the needs of production with regard to young specialists with certain competencies, but currently many programs of higher and secondary vocational education do not have time to adapt to the latest achievements in technological and production spheres. The article states that the development of students’ competencies is a key goal of educational programs and that they should be organized in such a way as to ensure consistent and systematic mastering of the necessary skills and knowledge. Competency-based approach in the sphere of higher professional education is realized through the development of exemplary basic educational programs that form a model of training. The article analyzes published studies and presented software products devoted to curriculum design. The article sets the task to form a set of disciplines, optimal in terms of labor intensity and levels of competence formation, which allows the most effective realization of the competences of the learner in the direction of bachelor’s degree, taking into account the level of formation set by the employer and the limitations of the curriculum. The mathematical model for solving the problem and the technology of designing the optimal competence model of a graduate taking into account the employer’s requirements are presented.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of E-learning and Blended Learning in Engineering Education through the Psychometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The work is devoted to the prospects for using psychometric indicators to improve the testing procedure in blended learning based on questions included in the assessment toolkit for the discipline. The systematic testing and analysis of test questions for the discipline “Fundamentals of Economics and Production Management” carried out as part of formative assessment has shown the feasibility of implementing a psychometric indicator system. Guided by the methodological recommendations of leading projects in the field of online learning, a part of the infographic that can be implemented based on data from the LMS Moodle has been determined.

articleTitle: The Cumulative Sum Algorithm as a Means for Detecting of the Time Series Disorder with a One-dimensional Exponential Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The issue of detection in real timescale a sudden abrupt change in the properties (disorder) of a time series with a one-dimensional exponential probability distribution function is considered. It is proposed to use the CUSUM detection algorithm to solve this problem. Using the simulation method, complete information was obtained that ensures the synthesis of the CUSUM detection algorithm with user-defined characteristics. The possibilities of using the information obtained during laboratory work on the course “Analysis of Stochastic processes” in the framework of the educational process at the Department of Management and Intelligent Technologies of the National Research University MPEI.

articleTitle: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in E-Learning Using the Example of the Deeptalk Software Product
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article provides a comprehensive overview and categorization of the various applications and implications of artificial intelligence (AI) in the field of education. It delves into the multifaceted role that AI plays, transcending its conventional function as a mere instrument to becoming a pivotal strategic partner that enhances pedagogical interactions. The authors argue that AI, through its advanced capabilities, is revolutionizing the educational landscape by fostering more personalized and efficient learning environments.One of the key highlights of the article is the detailed examination of the implementation of the DeepTalk software product within educational institutions in Russia. DeepTalk, a sophisticated AI driven platform, is designed to facilitate a more engaging and individualized learning experience. The case studies presented in the article illustrate how DeepTalk has been effectively integrated into classrooms, and the positive outcomes of such integrations in terms of student engagement and educational results.Furthermore, the authors propose a comprehensive classification system that outlines the various values AI brings to the educational sector. This classification helps to clearly understand the potential benefits and enhancements that AI can provide, such as adaptive learning programs, intelligent tutoring systems, and data-driven insights that inform educational strategies and policies.

articleTitle: SMath + Maxima - Powerful Tool for Engineering Calculations
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: SMath Studio is mathematical notebook software similar to Mathcad. Its outstanding and intuitive support for scientific units makes it an invaluable asset in higher engineering education. SMath Studio has been used for more than ten years in various courses at Brandenburg University of Applied Sciences, Germany (Technische Hochschule Brandenburg, THB). To enhance the usability of the software, substantial contributions have been made. One of them is the Maxima plugin for access to the free and open-source computer algebra system Maxima. This plugin combines the flexible notebook format of SMath Studio with powerful symbolic functions like integrals and solvers for algebraic and differential equations. Additionally, the plugin adds interactive 3D graphics to SMath. The paper discusses the basic design, features, and limitations, and showcases some applications.

articleTitle: To the Issue of the Comparison of 2D and 3D Modeling of Mechanical-Engineering Parts
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article provides a comparison of two methods for designing mechanical engineering parts using 2D and 3D modeling according to the following criteria:•speed of creating models.•responsibilities for creating models.•project editing capabilities.•information content of the model.•methods of manufacturing parts.As examples, assignments from the course “Engineering and Computer Graphics” of the Department of Modeling and Design of Power Installations (MDPI) of the National Research University “MPEI” were used, which the authors, students of this article, completed on the nanoCAD system.The authors believe that the course program “Engineering and Computer Graphics” of the Department of MDPI National Researching University “MPEI” is effective and relevant; the use of 3D modeling without mastering 2D modeling is not the right method of specialist education, because the latter provides the necessary skills in engineering graphics of complex mechanical-engineering parts.

articleTitle: Computer Models of an Optimally Controlled Inverted Physical Pendulum
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: A physical pendulum controlled by a motor located at a fixed point of suspension is considered in the work. The task is to bring and stabilize this pendulum in the upper unstable equilibrium position. Such a pendulum can be considered as a model of a person standing on an individual Segway-type vehicle. Two engine control algorithms based on the readings of the rotation angle and angular velocity sensors of the pendulum are considered. One of these algorithms maximizes the area of attraction of the upper equilibrium position, the second algorithm allows you to bring the pendulum to this position with minimal energy costs. Computer graphic illustrations help to understand the essence of these control algorithms. The construction of such drawings and animations based on the results of integrating differential equations of the controlled movement of a pendulum under various control laws is a meaningful educational task. This problem is solved by master’s students of the Department of Robotics, Mechatronics, Dynamics and Strength of Machines of the National Research University Moscow Power Engineering Institute when they study the course “Stability and stabilization of motion of dynamic systems.” The article discusses an example of performing such computational and graphical work using the Mathematica computer algebra system. Students present the result of the assignment in the form of a Mathematica program, a file with the nb extension. Such a program, as is known, contains text and executable cells, which allows you to ask not only questions involving symbolic transformations, numerical and analytical solutions, graphic constructions. It is also possible to formulate theoretical problems, the answer to which must be given in the form of text. The package Mathematica is available freely online on WolframCloud. To complete the task, the freely distributed computer algebra system Maxima can be used.

articleTitle: SMath Studio in the Engineering Personnel Training for Thermal Power Engineering and Heat Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The authors of this work demonstrate the usage of the SMath Studio environment for automated calculations when performing heat and power engineering and heat engineering tasks during the students training in the Heat and Power Engineering and Heat Engineering field. The paper provides examples of using the tools and capabilities of SMath Studio in solving applied problems. Examples of the thermodynamic cycle calculation and the humid air treatment calculation are shown.

Author Keywords: thermal power engineering and heat engineering

articleTitle: Visualization Algorithms for Rendering of Volumetric Clouds
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In the present paper, existing visualization algorithms for rendering of atmospheric clouds are described, particle system algorithm and raymarching algorithm are compared. The raymarching algorithm is chosen as a relevant visualization algorithm. Existing optimization strategies of raymarching algorithm are discussed. Rendering in low resolution is proposed to increase the performance. It is suggested to use the FXAA algorithm to maintain decent image quality. Application of different weather maps such as procedurally generated Perlin noise map and radar image is discussed. A study was conducted to investigate atmospheric clouds rendering techniques as well as suggest methods to improve rendering techniques. To demonstrate the results of the study a framework was developed using C++ language and OpenGL API.

articleTitle: Modeling the Processes of Distribution of Disinformation in the Internet Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article addresses the issue of the spread of misinformation in the online environment. It proposes the use of agent-based modeling to study and analyze this process. A model of an information agent for the process of spreading misinformation has been developed, represented by a graph of states and transitions of a probabilistic finite automaton. The structure is determined and the relationships between the transition probabilities of this automaton are established. An agent-based simulation model of the processes of dissemination of misinformation in the Internet environment has been developed using the NetLogo 6.3 multi-agent modeling system. The results of simulation experiments and assessment of the adequacy of the software model are presented. Options for using abstract and simulation models in the educational process of the direction “Information Systems and Technologies” are proposed.

articleTitle: MOOC Development For Artificial Intelligence and Decision-Making Specialists Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper considers the development of mathematical and software prototype of an information tool system such as Massive Open Online Courses (MOOC). An example of the application of this system in the development of online courses for training specialists in the field of artificial intelligence and decision-making is considered. These studies are conducted to improve the quality of training of specialists within the framework of educational programs in the field of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Department of Applied Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence of the National Research University “MPEI”.

articleTitle: Digital Educational Resources in Industrial Radiography
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Nowadays, the technological level of production is an important factor for all areas of modern economic development and life quality improvement. Neither in the informational, nor in the industrial sphere it is possible to produce in-demand, modern, and therefore high-tech and complex products without the establishment of an appropriate system of quality examination at multiple stages of production. This article deals with the problem of forming a comprehensive educational environment with the use of heterogeneous educational resources in the training of specialists in the radiation type of nondestructive testing. The purpose of the research and development is to address the shortcomings of classroom, remote digital learning, and laboratory practice listed in the article by developing a solution based on virtual reality technologies. The purpose stated lies in the pursuit of intensive solutions to the existing problems. Extensive development paths are not effective in improving the efficiency of training and checking students’ knowledge in the context of the rapidly growing demand for nondestructive testing specialists. The concept of a digital twin as an educational resource is considered. The structural approach to the formation of complex educational resources both at the level of organization and at the level of digital product is presented. The structure of interrelationships between data in the formation of a digital twin of a radiographic image is presented. The results of the radiographic image simulation and its quality verification are shown.

articleTitle: Implementation of a System for Teaching the Basics of Fuzzy Logic Inference Systems and Fuzzy Case-Based Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper presents a software module for working with fuzzy logic inference systems in the context of fuzzy case-based reasoning. Fuzzy logic, providing tools for describing and handling uncertainty, is an important component of engineering practice. The considered free software is used in the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute" and is implemented in the process of teaching master's degree students of "Applied Mathematics and Computer Science" in the discipline "Actual Problems of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science".

articleTitle: Ontological Approach to the Document Synthesis Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article presents a comprehensive study on the utilization of data mining technologies and ontological approaches in the field of government procurement. It highlights the complexities involved in defining procurement object requirements and developing technical specifications, which vary significantly from case to case. The study underscores the need for procurement professionals to possess extensive knowledge across various sectors due to the diversity of goods, works, and services procured. The adoption of Intelligent Data Analysis is proposed as a solution to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of procurement processes. The research investigates the potential of automating ontology construction to facilitate decision-making in creating technical specifications. It examines the legal framework governing government procurement and explores the capabilities of the Unified Information System for public procurement in Russia. The paper also describes the development of a typed ontology for public procurement, emphasizing the importance of an ontological approach in managing the large volume of multistructured information typical in procurement documentation. This approach is vital for the automated synthesis of necessary documents, offering significant support in decision-making processes. The article concludes with a detailed exploration of the ontological approach to document synthesis in government procurements. It outlines the process of selecting procurement subjects, conducting intellectual analysis of texts, and using intelligent data analysis techniques to ensure compliance with legal requirements.

articleTitle: A Software Package for Optimization of a Solar-Diesel Complex Operation Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article considers the basic principles of the solar-diesel complex operation mode control system. The methodology that allows to determine the most effective combination of operating equipment is proposed. The suggested solutions are evaluated for the conditions of the solar-diesel complex located in the city of Verkhoyansk, and it is carried out using the author’s software package.

articleTitle: New Educational Technologies for Training Specialists in the Field of Mechatronics and Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The development and integration of robotics education encompass a multifaceted approach that combines theoretical knowledge with practical application. The educational process is geared toward producing highly qualified specialists and supporting the development of innovative mechatronic modules and robotic systems. The article introduces new practice-oriented educational technologies designed to train specialists in mechatronics and robotics, with a focus on creating robotic systems for competitions and human interaction. The study has started at the Moscow Power Engineering Institute in 1931 with the activities of student design and engineering bureaus. Improving the professional level of graduates led to winning several international competitions, which had the greatest role in the formation of the Technology Support Center for Education in 2012. Scientific research continues to this day in the field of designing robots and finding optimal methods for their implementation. Ultimately, this study suggests prioritizing sponsorship and enhancing competition, offering additional technological and material resources to students and researchers, and formulating long-term strategies to anticipate and address technological obstacles. The article concluded by examining the step-by-step advancement of technical education in preparing skilled professionals in robotics and mechatronics, and highlighting the potential future prospects and obstacles for educating students in this field.

articleTitle: Introduction of the Image Processing and Machine Learning Techniques for Pupils
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of introducing some modern computer engineering techniques into the supplementary educational process for students of schools. The discussed techniques are as follows: image processing (color management, gamma correction, image quality improvement), steganography, classifiers based on different machine learning methods (artificial neural networks, decision trees, support vector machines). The goal is to create some scalable instruments for building up short-term (master-class format) or long-term (series of lectures and laboratories) courses, from 2 to 32 academic hours, for pupils of the 10th or 11th forms of the Russian high schools. The motivation, content of courses and the facilities used are described and some results of the courses implementation are discussed.

articleTitle: Possibilities of Integrating MOOCs in Humanitarian and Technical Students Foreign Language Curriculums
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article considers MOOCs as one of the ways to organize the learning of foreign languages in higher education by using information and communication technologies. The authors analyzed scientific papers devoted to foreign and domestic open educational platforms and courses hosted on them, and identified the main advantages and disadvantages of MOOCs. The purpose of the work is to find out the level of awareness and practical application of online format courses among the students. To achieve the goal, the following tasks were set: to conduct a survey of the students at the Translation Faculty of Minsk State Linguistic University (MGLU) and the students of technical specialities of Natioanal Research University “Moscow Power Engineering Institute” (NRU “MPEI”), to compare and analyze the results obtained. The possibility of using MOOCs as a part of the language training of humanitarian and technical students is also considered. As a result of this work, the authors came to the conclusion that, despite the advantages of using MOOCs in the pedagogical process, it was impossible to completely replace the classroom work with an online format course due to organizational difficulties.

articleTitle: The Simulation Model of the Optical Isolator Matching Unit for Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The analysis of modern electronic design automation tools is produced, and their key features are presented. The simulation model of the optical isolator matching unit is developed, and the simulation models of some elements are shown. The simulation modelling result of the scheme fragment is presented.

articleTitle: Modelling of Control System with Auto-Tuning Module in SimInTech
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper considers computer modelling of a single-loop linear control system with an auto-tuning module. A short review of the modelling software is given, the advantages of SimInTech are shown. The modelling is carried out in SimInTech using the tool called the package of project, that contains several projects which have a common data base containing all the variables. The control system under consideration, the control plant identification method and the project of the package are described. The control plant model is the second order transfer function with a time delay, the control algorithm is PID. An example for testing the package is given and analysed.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Machine Learning Model Using Neural Networks: a Case Study of Vehicle Motion Modeling Task
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article explores reinforcement learning through the development of a model for automatic control of a vehicle on a track within the context of a computer game. It describes the Q-learning method and its application in the DQN algorithm for agent training. The challenge of selecting the right volume of training data is discussed. The gaming model created to assess the impact of the number of machine vision sensors and neural network structure on the success of learning is outlined. Such a project can be implemented by students for training purposes to enhance their engagement in the learning process.

articleTitle: PED Department Schedule Preparation Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Implemented partial automation of the processes of distributing the academic load of the general education department of a large university and scheduling classes, as well as interactive correction of these documents during the semester in the event of various unforeseen situations.

articleTitle: Laboratory Information Technologies for Pore Water Analysis of Arctic Seabed Sediments
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Geological surveys include a comprehensive understanding of the object as a part of the natural system. Moreover, the processes of transformation of the investigated geological system in time and space can be correctly and quickly assessed only with the use of virtual models that simulate real variants of situations. Nowadays, geology has been significantly subjected to digitalization and introduction of various software complexes. Nevertheless, it is important not only to be able to apply software complexes for studies at various sites, but also to go beyond the proposed situations, using the full potential of the programs. This article describes information technologies used in the Laboratory of Hydrogeology, Hydrogeochemistry and Mathematical Modeling of Hydrogeological Processes of the Hydrogeology Department of Lomonosov Moscow State University to train students in the complex acquisition of geological information, as well as the implementation of the obtained knowledge for scientific research of the geological cycle. In particular, the application of information technologies is considered as an approach to understanding geochemical processes in the system “bottom sediments-pore water” on the shelf of the Arctic seas with the help of thermodynamic modeling software packages.

articleTitle: Information Technologies in Colorimetric Laboratory Research
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article introduces the integration of information technologies into colorimetric laboratory research. Software programs facilitate 3D modeling of laboratory specimens and enable qualitative object recognition, along with necessary colorimetric calculations. As an example, the development of a digital colorimeter for laboratory research on objects with complex shapes and various colors is presented. Such developments can serve as a viable alternative to laboratory setups and assist students in gaining practical experience with the processes of design, modeling, and information technologies. Colorimetric measurements are essential in various scientific and technical fields, such as the food and paint industries, gemology, genetics, and medicine.

articleTitle: Study of Direct-Flow Pulverized Coal Boiler Start- Up Modes Using the Boiler Designer Program
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper examines the stages of modeling the start-up modes of a modern pulverized-coal once-through boiler using the Boiler Designer program. Two different starting schemes were simulated. It is presented the formulation of the research problem, the main provisions for creating a computational model, the most significant modeling results, and the conclusions drawn from the analysis of these results.

articleTitle: Experience of Development and Application of Intelligent IT and Software in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This publication describes the experience of the Department of Applied Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence of the National Research University “MPEI” in the development of system and application software for the educational process using various intelligent information technologies. The importance of the developments carried out by the department in the Soviet period is noted and the modern developments of the department for the implementation of compilers, software using the language of decision tables and application software based on the fuzzy case-based reasoning approach are examined in detail.

articleTitle: Parameterization of Dynamic Objects Using 3D Scanning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In today’s world the use of 3D cameras is becoming increasingly common for analyzing physical objects and spaces. This technology makes it easier to obtain comprehensive data about the shape and appearance of various objects. Applications of 3D scanning systems cover various fields such as automation and control, medicine, construction, autonomous driving and the automotive industry. It is noteworthy that in modern professional training, much attention is paid to the use of 3D scanning capabilities. For students of various disciplines, mastering 3D data processing algorithms opens up valuable opportunities to integrate advanced technologies in their respective fields. This highlights the growing importance of 3D scanning in shaping the skills and knowledge of future professionals in various fields. This underscores the growing significance of 3D scanning in shaping the skill sets and expertise of future professionals. The article highlights a specific case where a 3D camera was utilized to evaluate the condition of cows on a farm. In this scenario, the cows were surveyed and algorithms were employed to carry out various tasks, including extracting the region of interest, preparing the data for analysis, positioning the subject of study, performing segmentation, and ultimately extracting the parameter of interest. Through these processes, the 3D images of the cows on the farm were leveraged to extract and evaluate key parameters.

articleTitle: Development of Devices to Help People with Disabilities as an Educational Process for Students to Learn the Basics of Programming, Electronics and Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses various devices and gadgets for people with disabilities and people with disabilities. Such devices and gadgets help disabled people and people with limited health abilities to better navigate space and remind them of dangerous objects. At the Russian State Social University, an important place is given to working with people with disabilities. There is a resource center and many elements of an accessible environment. Therefore, students for their design choose topics aimed at developing such devices, namely: device for spatial orientation of persons with disabilities (vision); device for primary assessment of room climate parameters; prototype of a robotic assistant for people with disabilities based on a KUKA industrial robotic manipulator with an electric gripper; a prototype of a robotic assistant for cargo delivery. These devices are developed by students while studying the basics of programming, electronics and robotics to gain primary skills in performing real projects. The students gain important experience in designing prototype systems that function in real-world environments and perform real-world tasks. In addition, it is valuable here for students to acquire programming skills in C++ (Wiring version for the Arduino platform), Python, Processing and others.

articleTitle: Construction of Polynomials for Calculating the Thermophysical Properties of Low-Boiling Working Substances
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Information technologies in the form of integrated electronic reference books and polynomials for determining the properties of working substances are widely used in engineering calculations and in the design of large-scale energy facilities. However, for a large number of small-scale energy projects, the interest in which increases from year to year, the use of non-traditional working substances is proposed. The analysis of the effectiveness of using such substances as working bodies of power plants, as well as the constructive elaboration of the elements of the thermal circuit, is significantly complicated by the need to repeatedly refer to reference books in “manual” mode, since modules for calculating thermophysical properties are often not integrated into modern computing programs. This paper presents a method for constructing polynomials of thermophysical properties of low-boiling working substances in the Wolfram Mathematica program. A step-by-step approbation of the proposed technique has been performed and approximation dependencies have been developed for calculating the properties of pentane in the single-phase region and on the saturation curve in the specified parameter ranges. The type (mathematical form) of polynomials for each of the considered areas of pentane properties is proposed. The properties were calculated based on the obtained dependencies and compared with the original data array. The calculated data on the properties of pentane by polynomials showed a good match with the initial reference data in a given range of parameters. All points of the algorithm for constructing polynomials are illustrated with screenshots of the program for ease of use of the technique.

articleTitle: Electronic Educational Resources in the Professional Culture of a Higher Education Teacher
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article examines the effectiveness of pedagogical activity. The notion of professional culture of a teacher is connected with the challenge of increasing efficiency. The article reviews the influence of industrial civilization on increasing the level of pedagogical skills, as well as explores social, proper-professional and moral-motivational components of the teacher’s culture. Much attention is given to reviewing students’ attitudes toward their understanding of the professional culture of the higher education teacher. In modern society, the use of electronic educational resources (EER) is an essential component of education. The modern student audience attaches great importance to the teacher’s ability to qualitatively use electronic educational resources when evaluating teaching skills. The use of EERs is a concrete “response” of methodological science to the “challenge” of modern society.

articleTitle: Application of Mathematical Packages in Simulation the Kinematics of a Multilink Manipulator in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this paper we presents the results of using the Wolfram Mathematica mathematical package in the educational process when solving the problem of describing the geometry and kinematics of a stationary robotic manipulator. The aim of the work is to demonstrate the possibilities of using a mathematical package to construct the workspace of a manipulator and visualize its simplified 3D model, which will allow students to improve their understanding of the system under study and solving of the educational problem. Also it will contribute to the acquisition of professional competencies within the educational process. The resulting visualization of the 3D model in the Wolfram Mathematica package allows to students to change the configuration of the manipulator, setting the angles of rotation of its links in real time. The results of the work can be used in teaching students studying in the specialty “Mechatronics and Robotics” and related specialties, which study the issues of modeling robotic manipulators.

articleTitle: Study of Induction Current Density Distributions in a Two-layer and Three-layer Medium of Protective Coatings of Steel Parts Using Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses an integrated approach to mathematical modeling and research of electromagnetic field parameters in a two-layer and three-layer conductive medium during induction heating of a cylindrical steel part with melting of the conductive coating using information technology, which provides for a joint consideration of the processes occurring in the induction heating device and in the part with a conductive coating. The surface distributions of current density in the coating and top layer of a steel part located inside a three-turn inductor were obtained. The current density distributions were obtained in an induction heating device and in a part with a conductive coating. An analysis of the distribution of current density along the depth of the coating and part at a frequency of 66 kHz was carried out, taking into account different temperatures and magnetic properties of the part and coating at different times of induction heating, taking into account two Curie points and heating modes of a two-layer and three-layer body. The advantages of this approach to the consideration and study of induction heating processes and devices are presented.

articleTitle: Optimization and Visualization of the Algorithm for Constructing a Second-Order Surface Defined by Nine Points
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper focuses on the results of the experimental implementation of the historical problem of constructing a second-order surface (quadric) defined by nine points. The problem is based on the well-known Engel’s algorithm (Engel J. H., 1889). The paper presents a block diagram of the algorithm. The software is additionally tested on the example of a new quadric. The algorithm is implemented by means of the basic geometric constructions, from setting nine points to the construction of a quadric surface. The software implementation proves to be of high accuracy. The designed visual model illustrates the function of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Finite Element Analysis in the Educational Process of Power Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article investigates the integration of computer-aided design (CAD) in the educational curriculum for power engineering students, focusing on the simulation of electric fields in high-voltage power transmission systems. The paper delves into both theoretical foundations and practical applications, illustrating the utilization of CAD as a powerful tool for modeling the intricate electromagnetic fields in overhead power lines. The report outlines a systematic approach for incorporating CAD into the educational process, providing students with a comprehensive understanding of the complexities involved in the analysis and design of transmission systems. Emphasis is placed on the significance of hands-on experience with CAD for developing competencies essential for modern power engineering practices.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Prototype of a System for Monitoring Web Portals of Educational Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This study is dedicated to the creation and examination of a prototype of the monitoring system for web portals of educational establishments in the Russian Federation. The objective of the project is to enhance the effectiveness of information resource administration in the educational domain, guaranteeing conformity of the content on official websites of educational institutions with contemporary requirements and regulations. The research paper outlines the fundamental aspects of the system: its structure and functionality, the technologies employed for its implementation, as well as the methods utilized for monitoring and data analysis. The developed prototype of the system has been successfully tested and demonstrates high accuracy of analysis of the structure and content of web portals of educational organisations. It is planned to expand the functionality with modules of intellectual analysis of text content using neural network algorithms.

articleTitle: Automation of the Methodological Support of the University’s Educational Programs Based on a Digital Educational Constructor
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The modern education system, like any other sector of the economy of modern society, is undergoing transformation under the influence of the intensive development of digital technologies. Digital technologies in education are designed to redistribute the work of university teaching staff by automating the processes of working with documents. A technological solution in the field of methodological support of educational programs at the university is a digital educational constructor, which is a technique for merging essential information on the educational process and a prepared digital document template with a preconfigured structure, fonts and action routes.The article presents the experience of digital transformation of the system of methodological support of educational programs on the example of the National Research University “MPEI” (Moscow). The materials provide a description of the essence of the digital transformation of the methodological support process, research materials on the assessment of target indicators, as well as the features of a digital solution based on the author’s software. The authors provide an overview of the main stages of implementation and lessons learned in the process of implementing a digital educational constructor.

articleTitle: Experience in Utilizing the “Project Expert” Program for Financial and Economic Calculations in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: this article provides a comprehensive review of the experience in utilizing the certified software product, “Project Expert,” developed by Expert Systems, a part of the Pro-Invest Information Technologies LLC group. The application of this software has been explored within the educational framework of the Department of Thermal Power Plants at the Federal State Budgetary Educational Institution of Higher Education “MPEI”. Specifically, the program plays a pivotal role in conducting course calculations for the discipline “Feasibility Study of Calculations in Thermal Power Engineering”. In the contemporary landscape, a thorough analysis of energy projects necessitates the incorporation of financial and economic analysis methods. The utilization of this certified software product not only facilitates the mastery of modern project effectiveness calculation methods but also significantly reduces the time required for executing similar calculations.

articleTitle: On the Experience of Developing an Engineering OOP Application by a Student Group
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The development of small applications for engineering calculations is a feasible, useful and interesting work for students of applied mechanics. In order to produce a workable application, it is necessary to have deep knowledge and competences in the field of mechanics, computational methods, information technologies. These knowledge and competences are improved if students are tasked not only to study the behavior of a mechanical system, e.g., a nonlinear dynamical system as described in this paper, but also to develop their own easy-to-use verified object-oriented tool.

Author Keywords: Dahl and Lu Gre friction models

articleTitle: Current Traffic Flow Modeling Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The constant increase in the traffic load on the street and road network of large cities leads to obsolescence and invalidation of existing methods of organizing traffic within the transport network. This review is an introduction to mathematical modeling of traffic flows and gives an idea of the main areas of research and problem statements where it is used.

articleTitle: About the Difficulties of a Complete Transition to Computer-Based Teaching of the Course “Engineering and Computer Graphics”
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Computer-aided design technologies have become dominant in the industrial, technological and household spheres. Computer-aided design systems (CAD) represent an important link in industrial design, widely used in many industries, including energy. Computer graphics based on computer platforms (nanoCAD, AutoCAD, Kompas 3D, T-FLEX CAD, etc.) actively replaces pencil design in universities. The complete transition to computer-based learning is associated with a radical change in teaching technology and requires teachers to restructure a number of existing developments, and a system of work evaluating, fixing comments and marks [1–7].The authors of this publication summarize their experience of a complete transition to computer training in the course “Engineering and computer Graphics”.

articleTitle: File Sharing Based on Trust Networks and Public Key Certificates
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The shortcomings of existing software tools for file sharing are noted. To eliminate the shortcomings, a project of a client-server application based on building a network of trust using public key certificates of its participants has been developed. The project uses symmetric and asymmetric cryptography algorithms, methods for building trust networks and using public key certificates to ensure the authenticity, confidentiality and integrity of data. The server part and the client mobile application have been implemented, allowing users to exchange files with each other within one specific file storage. When developing the application, technology was used to facilitate its portability to other operating platforms. The client application is built and tested on devices running the Android operating system. The developed application has the functionality necessary for file hosting and ensures the authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of the transferred files. This allows it to be used both by groups of private users and in corporate information systems. The results of the work can be used in conducting classes in the disciplines “Data Protection” and “Programming Technology”, as well as in the organization of the educational process.

articleTitle: Digital Training of Engineering Personnel as the Basis for Ensuring Sustainable Development of Industry During the Transition to the Sixth Technological Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Digital training of engineering personnel is today a priority task for the development of the education system, since the need for specialists capable of working, designing and creating information systems of an applied engineering nature is high in all sectors of the technological economy of the world. The development of training specialists in the field of digitalization of engineering activities is currently chaotic. There is a penetration of the profession in the field of information and computer technology into all engineering specialties and the need for multi-level digital literacy for specialists in various industries is being formed.This article attempts to substantiate the need to include modules for practice-oriented digital training of engineering personnel in educational programs. Two tasks were considered as part of the ongoing research. First, the prerequisites for the formation of requirements for specialists in engineering professions based on changes in the economy of the country and the development of the sixth technological order. The second is the justification of the structural minimum for the competencies of engineering personnel in the context of practice-oriented labor market requirements for young professionals for the Russian industrial complex. The article provides an overview of the state of the problem and presents options for its solution based on the concept of sustainable development.

articleTitle: Development of Classification System for Corporate Portal User Requests
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development of classification system for corporate portal user requests using machine learning algorithms. Text corpus preprocessing including irrelevant characters removal, normalization and stop words exception was performed. Two different feature generation methods were tried for vector representation building of words: the TF-IDF method and the FastText vector space model. Data set was split into training, validation and test samples. Experimental search for the optimal value of the feature space dimension using the TF-IDF method was carried out. Four classification algorithms were applied to solve the task: logistic regression, Gaussian naïve Bayesian classifier, k-nearest neighbors classifier and artificial neural network. The classifiers were trained on the training sample. The grid search algorithm was used for the most appropriate hyperparameter detection. The developed system performance was tested using several classification metrics on the validation and test samples.

articleTitle: A Framework for Cognitive Visualization of Passive Electrical Components Properties
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to the implementation of a framework designed to visualize deviations in the characteristics of electrical components. A cognitive-graphical image “Leaves” is used. An algorithm for transferring data to an image is proposed. Each sheet demonstrates a separate parameter of an electrical component. The problems of the implementation of our approach are considered. The interface is discussed, as well as options for its integration with CAD.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Support for Assistant Selection for Checking Works with Free Response in Massive Open Online Courses with the Use of Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In massive open online courses (MOOCs), a teacher’s assistant role is very significant because the most important functions of tutors are delegated to assistants. Considering a huge number of students on every launch of the MOOC, the tutor is not able to serve it alone. The studies associated with the use of teacher’s assistants in online courses are focused on different aspects. However, the former do not address the question connected with the consideration of assistants’ ability to form response to performed works with free response (WWFRs) for the students properly, in detail and close to tutor’s feedback. The response obtained by the student will determine whether the required skills will be formed at him. This problem is particularly serious for engineering education with the presence of a large number of WWFRs: practical works, labs and other works. To cope with this issue, a method of intelligent decision support for assistant selection for checking WWFRs is suggested in the paper. The method contains the steps: the preliminary selection of assistants on eliminating criteria; organization of performance of assessment of works, earlier evaluated by the tutor, by assistants-candidates; definition of the quality of evaluation conducted by assistants-candidates by identifying the degree of similarity of their and tutor’s assessment results, employing text-mining. The proposed method was implemented in software using Moodle based learning management system and author’s application and tested on data on course “Information resource management” at university.

articleTitle: The Effect of Drop-Shaped Pin Fin on the Heat Transfer of Finned Tube
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The heat transfer characteristics of airflow passing over a tube embedded with pin fins have been numerically investigated. A comparison was made between circular and drop-shaped pin fins, both having identical cross-sectional areas and arranged in-line. The Reynolds number, based on the hydraulic diameter, varied from 5430 to 27170. The effectiveness of the drop-shaped pin fins was found to be higher than that of the circular pin fins by $4.88-19.59 \%$. Concerning specific performance parameters, drop-shaped pin fins emerge as an encouraging alternative configuration to their circular counterparts.

articleTitle: Informatization of Strategic Research Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to current issues of informatization of strategic management of the scientific field in engineering education at the operational level. The article reflects the relationship between the scientific sphere and engineering education, and also provides the tracks of digital transformation of higher engineering education in the Russian Federation, one of which is the “digital university” track. One of the main objectives of this project is to monitor scientific activity and related processes. This study showed the need to ensure informatization and the introduction of digital technologies in the implementation of the strategy of scientific activities of departments in order to maintain the competitiveness of universities implementing areas of engineering education. The developed informatization security of the methodology for ranking the performance of departments in the scientific field will allow us to quickly solve problems that arise on the way to ensuring the competitiveness of technical universities.

articleTitle: Development of a Cross-Platform Interpreter for the muLISP Language
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Lisp is one of the basic functional programming languages. There are many modifications and implementations of language dialects, but stable and simple implementations that have proven their reliability over time are often used in the educational process. Such implementations include muLisp. The paper is devoted to the development of a cross-platform interpreter for the muLISP language. The main points of its internal structure are outlined: analysis of input expressions, representation of built-in functions, the computation process and memory management mechanisms. Numerous software tools used to develop the compiler are presented.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control and Simulation of Production Processes Using Temporal Neuro-Fuzzy Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Complex systems surround people in many industries. In the process of functioning, complex systems need to overcome various difficulties associated with the influence of external factors, peculiarities of the functioning of processes, etc. Complex system is influenced by a complex and rapidly changing set of external conditions, where effective planning and optimization of resources become key success factors, while the possible trajectories of the production of complex technical objects, the employment plan of equipment and personnel, which helps to optimize processes and reduce production costs. The article examines one of the classes of complex systems, and also proposes a method for adaptive control of systems of this class using temporal neuro-fuzzy Petri nets. These networks combine the concepts of Petri nets, a graphical system modeling and analysis tool, with neural networks and fuzzy logic. Considered algorithmic and software for the implementation and support of processes. The proposed method makes it possible to increase the efficiency of a complex system under changing operating conditions. caused by the influence of various factors.

articleTitle: Contemporary Optimization Problems and Metaheuristics in the Course of Operations Research
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Digital transformation needs new competency models and digital competencies improvement and expansion. As some models of digital competencies were developed and published, it is expedient and necessary to extend the existing discipline programs with the goal to improve student’s digital competencies. In the current research we consider the example of extension and adaptation of the Operations Research discipline in the bachelor’s 01.03.04 “Applied mathematics” curriculum. The particular problem of this discipline in the aspect of digital competencies is that the practical part of the course includes consideration of those optimization problems, which do not relate to the contemporary technical systems. It limits possibility to improve some digital professional competencies. The adding of relevant numerical optimization methods to the discipline program allows to make the problem examples much more complicated and to bring them closer to the development, design and optimization of real-life technical systems. The general aim of such discipline extension is to improve the professional competency in problem solving, digital content creation and information literacy as well.

articleTitle: Determination of Statisic Parameters of Jet Element Operability
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This study covers the operation of a mono-stable jet distributor in a modular design for controlling pneumatic actuators and indications. This study will give an insight into the operation of jet elements, namely the flow in the flow section. For this purpose, a calculation was carried out using the geometry of the original Volga elements. The results obtained are suitable for the study of the operation of alternative jet elements.

articleTitle: Digital Tools in Educational Activities
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: It is impossible to imagine the modern rapidly changing world without digital technologies, which are actively penetrating all areas of human productive activity. Competition predetermines the rapid replacement of some technologies by others, and, as a result, there is a need for continuous replenishment of knowledge and the acquisition of new skills and competencies for career growth and business success in the training of modern specialists. The modern educational environment responds to the challenges of the time with rapidly developing information technologies and digital tools, providing students with new opportunities for effective learning and professional development. Digital skills in the educational environment cover a wide range of competencies: from skills in working with computer programs to analyzing data sets and developing mobile applications. Competition predetermines the rapid replacement of some technologies by others, and, as a result, there is a need for continuous replenishment of knowledge and the acquisition of new skills and competencies for career growth and business success in the training of modern specialists. The modern educational environment responds to the challenges of the time with rapidly developing information technologies and digital tools, providing students with new opportunities for effective learning and professional development. Digital skills in the educational environment cover a wide range of competencies: from skills in working with computer programs to analyzing data sets and developing mobile applications.

articleTitle: Prospects for the Software Using for Modeling Water Treatment Processes in the Specialists Training in the Field of Technosphere Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of improving the quality of the educational process of students studying in the field of “Technosphere Safety” at the National Research University “MPEI”. The problems that arise for students when studying courses related to water purification are analyzed. The feasibility of using special software for modeling the water purification process and individual purification devices is shown. Popular software products currently used in practice in the design and operation of wastewater treatment plants are considered. The capabilities of modern software systems that can be useful in the educational process of bachelor’s and master’s degrees are shown. Examples of Russian software products are given that can be used in the educational process of training environmental specialists.

articleTitle: The Model of Comprehensive Assessment of the Level of Development of Students’ Cognitive Abilities
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The implementation of modern standards of higher education actualizes the problem of developing students’ cognitive abilities, which leads to the need to develop an educational system, the main goal of which is the development of cognitive abilities. To design the described system and further manage it, it is necessary to solve the problem of assessing the level of development of students’ cognitive abilities. This article proposes a model for a comprehensive assessment of the level of development of cognitive abilities, presents the results of electronic comprehensive study of students in the process of innovation, and draws conclusions about the applicability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Development, Modeling and Prototyping of a Balun Transformer for Powering an Induction-Resistive Heating System Using Modern CAD and CAE Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article is devoted to simulation modeling and research of electromagnetic processes in special balun transformers (electromagnetic phase number converters) used to power induction-resistive heating systems, as well as calculation of their electrical and energy characteristics. The work compares modern power supplies for an induction-resistive heating system for industrial pipelines. A circuit of an electromagnetic phase number converter based on a Scott transformer circuit for powering a single-phase load is proposed. A mathematical model of the proposed balun transformer was obtained, implemented as a simulation model in the MATLAB/Simulink package, and its characteristics were calculated.

articleTitle: Statistical Evaluation of Control of Performing Works with Free Response in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In online learning, the main knowledge and skill assimilation control tool is tests. Also in learning management systems, such a tool as an assignment is used for control over performing works with free response (WWFRs) (laboratory works, course works, etc.). The application of this tool is particularly important in case of engineering education, when students perform a significant number of WWFRs throughout the entire period of study. The means of control statistical evaluation in training is necessary for the identification of problems with tests and test items, and also with course materials for their subsequent revision. The current solutions are primarily aimed at the statistical evaluation of tests and items belonging to them, at the same time there are used two approaches to pedagogical measurements: classical test theory (CTT) and item response theory (IRT). Several studies are focused on questions related to the assignment evaluation. However, in the former, the emphasis is not on the assignment itself (the correctness of elements it contains), but on other aspects mainly connected to the assessing procedure. In the paper, a new approach to statistical evaluation of control over performing WWFRs, considering the assignment as a system of its parts, utilizing typical mistake base and rooted in a dichotomous two-parameter (2PL) IRT-model, is proposed. The approach was piloted on data on performing a calculation and graphic work on the university course “Project Workshop” with the usage of author’s software.

articleTitle: The Role of YouTube in Country Studies Teaching to Technical Students
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article researches the use of YouTube in teaching country studies aspects to technical students. In fact, there are a lot of different online resources to study and teach, but Youtube is the most popular and technically advanced video hosting service. In this research several YouTube channels in English, Russian and German are investigated and compared. These are independent channels, created by journalists and enthusiasts and not by big networks like BBC, Discovery channel etc. All the analysed channels deal with historical, cultural and social aspects of the world. In the end, this paper highlights advantages and disadvantages of using YouTube in teaching/studying country studies.

articleTitle: Educational Software Package “Calculation of the Photovoltaic Module Output”
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article describes a software package for several types of calculations needed in solar energetics: solar energy calculation; modeling an array of hourly total and diffuse solar irradiance values for given point for arbitrary oriented surface and calculating single PV module operating mode with or without taking in account temperature effect. Calculations implemented in software package are required during engineering both large grid-connected solar PV power plants and solar PV units within energy complexes. Described software’s set-in databases, list of the targeted tasks and assumptions. Also, provided information about future software’s improvements and its usage in education process or applied research.

articleTitle: University 3.0 and Graduate Competence in Modern Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The Universaty 3.0 model is a response to the challenge of the Fourth industrial revolution shaping Industry 4.0, which requires new qualities of engineering work. In the theoretical interpretation, the University 3.0 includes three key areas of activity - teaching, research, and entrepreneurship. The main implementation figure is the graduate. What competencies the graduate of University 3.0 should have and what new requirements for their qualifications does the model of the University 3.0 within the framework of “entrepreneurial university” suggest? The article provides an overview of some aspects of this topic.

articleTitle: Organization of Support and Education for Adults in the Context of Transition to the Concept of Information Society
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Development of an information-based society is a priority for the future. Educational system is one of the fundamental components, and teaching adults who require new digital competencies is one of the main directions of the development. The article is focused on researching interactions between adult students and educational organizations on the basis of a cross-functional mechanism that will help to compare different states of interaction and select their balanced combinations. The article represents the structural flow chart of the formation of a system of sustainable business development and innovative solutions under the influence of the educational sector and government support measures. The feature of the proposed approach is a development of digital competencies on the basis of entropy approach, which allows assessing the effectiveness of information exchange between subjects of educational activities.

articleTitle: Developing a 3D Converter Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article shows the possibility of using 3D simulation methods to improve educational resources and teaching materials. Using Altium Designer software, we created a composite 3D model of the converter, demonstrating its structure. The 3D model allows considering the physical appearance of its components. Based on the software module, a video review was recorded showing a detailed description of the device and explaining the principles of its operation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Stability and postcritical Behavior of the Ziegler’s Pendulum in Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper presents a nonlinear Simulink model of a double pendulum loaded with potential and follower forces. At first stability region of the initial equilibrium position was found using the dynamic method. Then time-depended displacements and phase portraits of the pendulum were obtained and investigated for various parameters of the loading: in the stable regions, at the intersection of the boundaries of flutter and divergence, in distant postcritical regions. In the simulation some features of phase trajectories of the nonlinear nonconservative system have been found and illustrated. The relevance of simulation for training future specialists in the field of dynamics and strength of machines is shown.

articleTitle: Universal Device for Educational Process of Gathering Magnetic Properties Data
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Training specialists in non-destructive testing is a very important task. To teach magnetic and eddy current methods, real objects with different properties are required. They are very expensive. To solve this problem, a device has been developed that allows you to take the necessary readings, process and obtain data on the magnetic properties of the sample. The technical implementation of a device for collecting data and sending the received parameters to a computer is presented. An automated system for accounting for all errors will allow you to quickly generate a report on the object, taking into account the applied currents and linear dimensions, and form an object passport, which greatly simplifies the process of creating various samples for eddy current and magnetic control methods.

articleTitle: Determination of Thermodynamic Properties of Under-Researched Liquids Based on Limited Information About Properties
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article considers a method for obtaining information on the thermodynamic properties of under-researched liquids at pressures significantly exceeding atmospheric pressure. The method is the same, but the initial data are different: in one case, only the density, isobaric heat capacity and the speed of sound at atmospheric pressure are known, and in the other, the same parameters, but along the saturation line. The method is based on the assumption of a linear dependence of the specific volume (density) on pressure and temperature in the liquid phase.

articleTitle: Virtual Laboratory Work “Isochoric Heating of Water and Water Vapor”
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: A virtual laboratory work allows us to study the properties of a real gas in an isochoric process. The isochoric process mathematical model takes into account the peculiarities of the properties of water and water vapor; accurate tabular data are used to describe thermodynamic parameters in one- and two-phase regions. The necessary thermodynamic properties are described by several virial equations using software package the Mathematica-10. The results of the interactive experiment form to study the dependence of density on temperature and pressure of a substance in single-phase and two-phase regions during isochoric heating. Isochoric heating is investigated at specific volume values less than critical and greater than the critical one. The developed computer model is implemented in independent mode and applicable for conducting the experiment. The installation of additional programs on the computer is not allowed.

articleTitle: What do a Computer and Weapons have in Common? Comparative analyses of Cyberattacks and non-lethal weapons
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problems of determining the legal norms that apply to cyberattacks. The main question explored in the article is whether cyberattacks are a type of non-lethal weapons, since, depending on the answer to this question, the rules governing the use of non-lethal weapons (or weapons in general) may or may not be applied to cyberattacks. The study was carried out using the formal legal method, the method of comparative analysis, synthesis, deductive and inductive methods, interviewing. In recent years, the international community has paid close attention to the problem of cyberattacks. This happens due to the increasing incidence of such attacks and their practical uncontrollability. Despite this, there are very few studies that are devoted to the consideration of cyberattacks as non-lethal weapons or weapons; in Russian legal doctrine they are practically absent. This article provides a detailed comparison of cyberattacks and non-lethal weapons according to six specific criteria, which helps to identify common features between these two phenomena, as well as to find the fundamental differences between them.
