The article concludes that cyberattacks are not a type of non-lethal weapons and the use of these phenomena should be regulated by different norms and principles.

articleTitle: Website XPS.mpei.ru: a Tool for XPS Analysis of Solid Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This work presents the website XPS.mpei.ru. The website enables its users to create and control the experimental photoelectron spectra database, perform XPS profiling of solid surfaces (Element Analysis, Quantitative Analysis, Phase Analysis).

articleTitle: Educational Desktop for Remote Modeling of Secure Cyber-Physical Systems Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The educational resource proposed in this work is intended for remote study of some combinatorial block designs and communication protocols of secure cyber-physical systems based on them, taking into account possible options for compromising keys and methods for capturing them. To construct such protocols and subsequently analyze them, five algorithms inherent in a balanced incomplete combinatorial block design (BIBD) of any type are used. These are algorithms for constructing a block, constructing a dual block, calculating the intersection of two blocks and the intersection of two dual blocks, as well as an algorithm for computing the list of blocks intersecting with each of two disjoint blocks (or two blocks truncated by removing a common block element). Five such algorithms for the unital BIBD are presented. We consider systems equipped with key ring systems or key space systems with a guaranteed security parameter. Schemes for the execution of some protocols with specified detail options are provided, as well as options for training assignments for such protocols. The educational resource allows you to remotely simulate processes in cyber-physical systems of both types, taking into account the specified restrictions concerning keys compromising and capturing. Such laboratory workshops play an important role and are an obligatory part of the educational process in the professional training of masters in applied mathematics and informatics.

articleTitle: Implementation of Fault Tolerance in Cyber Range Orchestration System Based on Indigenous Software
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article focuses on the implementation of fault tolerance in cyber range orchestration systems using indigenous software. It emphasizes the increasing necessity for fault tolerance in cyber ranges, particularly in the context of heightened cyber threats and the mandate for technological independence in critical information infrastructure, as outlined in a decree by the Russian Federation. The research highlights the importance of fault tolerance in maintaining continuous operation despite failures, and explores key strategies like load balancing, data backup and replication, system scaling, and the use of indigenous software technologies. The article also discusses the methodologies for assessing the fault tolerance of a cyber range, such as the Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and the Mean Time To Failure (MTTF).

articleTitle: Mathematical Method for Determining the Main Characteristics of Gas and Steam Turbines of a Single-shaft Combined Cycle Gas Turbine Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: One of the difficulties arising in processing the results of thermal tests of single-shaft combined cycle gas turbine units (CCGTs) is the separation of the generated electric power of the CCGT between the gas turbine (GT) and the steam turbine (ST). The paper proposes a method of determining these capacities based on mathematical methods. Correlation equations for calculating the value of electric power of GT and PT are compiled. To obtain the correlation coefficients, the experimental data of GT tests at operation as part of a single-shaft combined cycle gas turbine CCGT with a steam turbine disconnected from the generator were involved. The obtained equations were compared with the test results, which indicate the suitability of the equation for determining the values of electric power of GT and ST.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of FRL Language Interpreter and Integrated Development Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Lisp is one of the basic functional programming languages. There are many modifications and implementations of language dialects, but stable and simple implementations that have proven their reliability over time are often used in the educational process. Such implementations include muLisp. FRL is one of the oldest languages for describing and representing knowledge, based on the frame model. It is an extension of the Lisp language. The work is devoted to the development of an implementation of the FRL programming language and the development of an integrated environment for the LISP and FRL languages, allowing them to be used conveniently and efficiently.

articleTitle: Integrating Reinforcement Learning Methods with Neural Networks and Fuzzy Logic in Real-Time Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to the training of specialists in the field of information technology and artificial intelligence tasks. Since the 2021/2022 academic year, NRU MPEI has been implementing master’s degree studies in the Artificial Intelligence program, within which students acquire theoretical and practical skills in solving artificial intelligence problems, including using reinforcement learning methods in intelligent real-time decision support systems. As part of the research approach, the article offers a comparative analysis of the use of fuzzy logic in reinforcement learning methods compared to other artificial intelligence methods, including neural networks. This analysis reveals the advantages and limitations of each method, which is important for students of artificial intelligence who seek to comprehensively understand various approaches and apply them in various fields.

articleTitle: Computational Studies of the Combustion of Hydrogen Containing Gases in Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of greenhouse gas emissions and various methods of reducing their emissions from the combustion of organic fuels in power plants are considered. The volumes of reducing carbon dioxide emissions due to the conversion of coal-fired thermal power plants to natural gas and the introduction of advanced technologies at thermal power plants are estimated. The prospects of burning pure hydrogen in the combustion chamber of a modern gas turbine engine are shown.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling as a Means of Optimizing the Parameters of an Aerodynamic Vibration Damper Prototype for Overhead Power Line Wires
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article shows the use of CAD simulations in research and development of new devices, such as an aerodynamic vibration damper for overhead power line wires. Also considered are options for calculating the mass and layout of devices that dampen the water hammer of high-speed wind pressure on the absorber and wire using various materials as a function of the magnitude of the high-speed wind pressure in a given area of operation of the overhead power line. Research work has been carried out to compare variants of the ratios of the sizes of aerodynamic dampers when analyzing their total mass, taking into account the preservation of all parameters that determine the damping of the oscillatory process of wires at different values of the wind speed acting on the wire.

articleTitle: Heat and Mass Transfer and Modern Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of compromise in teaching the course Heat and Mass Transfer in universities, associated with two extremes - with manual (calculator) counting and the use of specialized software tools that implement finite element methods. The method of solving TMO problems in the environment of the domestic free program SMath is touched upon.

articleTitle: Development of Computer Programs for Calculation of Induction-Resistive Heating Systems for Industrial Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The principle of operation is considered and an algorithm for numerical calculation of an induction-resistive heating system is presented, taking into account the hysteresis of steel and the interaction of an electromagnetic field with a multilayer conductive medium of an induction-resistive heater. Based on this, the IRSN PRO program was developed to calculate the characteristics of this system. With the help of programs, comprehensive studies of the electrical and energy parameters of the system were carried out depending on the inductor current and heating temperature. A nonlinear substitution scheme for an induction-resistive heating system and a mathematical description of the parameters of this scheme for designing a power supply are also proposed.

articleTitle: Experience in Using Modern Universal Software, Information and Internet Technologies in the Training of Chemical Technologists
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The results of the development of electronic educational resources for the advancement of the disciplines “Universal software tools for solving mathematical problems” and “Basics of information and Internet technologies” are presented as well as their realization in the Moodle learning management system. These disciplines are taught in Mendeleev University of Chemical Technology of Russia within the profile “Basic processes of chemical productions and chemical cybernetics” of the direction of bachelor training 18.03.02 Energy- and resource-saving processes in chemical technology, petrochemistry and biotechnology.

articleTitle: Educational Resources for Remote Comparative Study of Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Studying machine learning methods for working with images is important in the education of future information technology specialists. In this regard, software tools are considered for interactive educational study and comparison of the methods for training generative adversarial networks for image inpainting, image super-resolution, and global illumination rendering for 3D scenes. The educational resource is represented as a configuration of TensorFlow and Jupyter Notebook environment tools. It enables remote study of the impact on image inpainting quality of the addition of residual blocks to the generator network, adjustments to the networks’ learning rate, and the proportion of damaged pixels in the input data. Additionally, the educational resource supports interactive tools for remote studying of the super-resolution method in comparison to bicubic interpolation. It also explores the effect of using various upsampling methods and applying different components of the loss function. Furthermore, the method of global illumination rendering from rasterized maps is studied in comparison to the ray tracing method. It allows for the study of the effect of adding a low-resolution ray-traced image to the input using the proposed educational resource. The workbench is utilized in the laboratory practice for the "Methods of Machine Learning" course for students of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science.

articleTitle: Distance Learning Course to Support Individual Work on Studying the German Language in a Master’s Program at a Technical University (Case Study)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the empirical experience of constructing a distance learning course for master’s students in technical areas of training studying the German language. A review of current literature on the topic is given, and the necessity and possibility of introducing a supporting course for independent individual work of students in conditions of low motivation to study a non-core subject and a shortage of classroom hours for contact work is substantiated. The structure of the developed course is given, covering the language sections (lexical and grammatical, text reading, watching video material, and developing listening skills). Content and language integrated learning (CLIL) and the flipped classroom approach act as the basic methodological principles for constructing training materials. According to the examination of the soft CLIL characteristics, the subsequent steps for incorporating this approach into foreign language instruction were justified: 1) evaluating and choosing the appropriate educational and methodological resources; 2) disseminating the tools and methods of pedagogical communication; 3) integrating CLIL directly into the learning experience. The proposed approach does not require a complete transition to teaching in a foreign language but uses it as an additional tool for the in-depth study of subjects. Learners study specialized subjects in their native language while being able to use a foreign language to obtain additional information and conduct research. This helps develop their language skills while being immersed in the subject area.

articleTitle: Information Technologies in the Design of Energy Efficient Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The introduction of energy efficient technologies in the construction and reconstruction of residential buildings is a necessary and mandatory condition for improving the environmental situation in populated areas and on the earth in general. Increasing the energy efficiency of buildings, first of all is a reduction in the specific value of energy resource consumption, which can be achieved by the use of architectural, functional-technological, structural and engineering solutions that affect the energy efficiency of buildings, as well as the use of devices, materials and technologies that are used in buildings, with the aim of rational use of energy resources. This involves simultaneous consideration of many parameters to obtain an informed choice of architectural, structural, and engineering solutions. The article discusses the use of information technologies in the design of energy efficient buildings, pays special attention to the stage of creating a project concept and proposes to carry out energy modeling as a separate stage of design work. At the energy modeling stage, the authors propose an algorithm/methodology using the Design PH, PHPP, Archicad, Ansys software packages, which makes it possible to justify the selected solutions for the building envelope and building engineering systems with high energy efficiency indicators, close to the passive house standard. The information model is generated in the Archicad program, which performs preliminary energy modeling and calculations of thermal bridges. The initial model with its parameters is translated into the PHPP program, where the energy balance of the building is calculated based on extensive initial parameters and systems, the energy balance is calculated with changes in the selected system parameters, the results are compared, and a reasonable best solution is selected. The information model is generated in the Archicad BIM environment in such a way that it can be used at all stages of design, as well as in subsequent life cycles. With the development of software, it becomes possible for all related specialists, as well as the customer, to interactively participate in a single BIM model, which significantly speeds up the development and approval of the project, increases the ability to use and manipulate a huge amount of parametric data to create an energy efficient project, optimize construction and life cycle. The article provides an example of the use of information technology in the design of an energy efficient residential building in the Moscow region.

articleTitle: Digital Platforms and Tools for Teaching English at a Technical University
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article researches the possibilities of using digital technologies in teaching a foreign language at a technical university. Online platforms, tools and innovative methods applied in teaching a foreign language at a technical university are analyzed and described. The study revealed the advantages of using digital technologies. A survey of technical students to identify the main pros of online platforms and tools was conducted. The results obtained confirm that using digital technologies in teaching a foreign language at a technical university improves students’ progress, increases motivation and interest in learning English, helps to improve students’ knowledge and makes the process of learning and teaching a foreign language more interactive and creative.

articleTitle: AI in Foreign Language Learning in Engineering Education: the Benefits and Challenges of Using ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This study examines the use of artificial intelligence in foreign language learning in engineering education. Some issues concerning learning a foreign language at a non-linguistic department are underlined. The benefits and possible challenges of using ChatGPT and ways to deal with the challenges are examined. Practical ways of ChatGPT use in Foreign language class are suggested (preliminary stage, training stage of working with ChatGPT, Practicing ChatGPT based bots (vocabulary replenishment, studying and practicing the rules of English grammar, written practice, learning writing styles, conducting a dialogue) and the set of 12 requests on the topic “Thermodynamics” as an illustration of the practical use of ChatGPT by first-year students of the faculties “Thermal Energy and Thermal Engineering” and “Nuclear Energy and Thermal Physics” are presented. Besides, the tips for ChatGPT use stated by students during ChatGPT practice are given. Students’ attitude study of ChatGPT use based on an after-practice questionary is exposed.

articleTitle: University Students Interdisciplinary Training of Educational Resources Design for Computer Modeling in School Engineering Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: School graduates of technology profiles classes are often seen as the most prepared potential applicants for engineering universities. Future engineers will need to apply modeling to solve problems that emerge in professional activities building on the school primary engineering learning. The construction of physical processes 3D models in computer environments can aid in the development of engineering thinking and digital training. This requires the electronic educational resources design and the development of suitable methods. The collaboration between pedagogical and engineering universities can facilitate the accomplishment of these tasks provided with methodical basis and a consolidation of the universities scientific and practical developments in the network interaction. One of the popular areas for training future engineers is distance project design where tasks are distributed among several performers. The issue of interdisciplinary design of electronic educational resources to ensure the quality of engineering training in technological profiles in schools is significant for the theory and practice of innovation in engineering education, pedagogical methodology and technology, and digital didactics. The proposed methods include computer modeling of physical processes in engineering (using materials science example), pedagogical design, and educational outcomes analysis. The paper describes the results of experimental work on organizing interdisciplinary projects for the development of electronic educational resources for school engineering learning by student teams. These teams consist of pedagogical university students, future teachers, and polytechnic university students, future engineers. It concludes that interdisciplinary training of students from pedagogical and engineering universities in the electronic educational resources design on computer modeling for school primary engineering learning is effectively feasible using distributed educational technologies. The outcome may be useful for early schoolchildren involvement in innovative engineering initiatives through participation in research projects and STEM Olympiads including multi-language educational events.

articleTitle: The Use of Electronic Testing Systems for Knowledge Control in Occupational Safety Training
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The relevance of electronic testing in comparison with other forms of control and assessment of the mastery of the material covered in the discipline is considered. An analysis was carried out of 6 popular services for compiling electronic tests for students. The following characteristics were taken into account: an intuitive interface, no special knowledge to create a test, aesthetic design, no restrictions on the number of tests and students being tested, joint editing of the test with colleagues, automatic evaluation of answers and scoring, limiting attempts to pass the test, the ability to view student comments, free to use. It has been established that one of the most popular, simple, convenient online testing services is Google Forms, which not only allows you to quickly and freely create online tests of any type, but also allows the teacher to save time on collecting and processing data and provides the opportunity to access the results testing as necessary. A properly selected online service for testing students allows you to correctly evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and the learning process itself in order to adjust it. The use of information technologies in the field of occupational safety training contributes to an increase in the quality of work performed in production and a reduction in injury rates.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Information Technologies for Multi-Agent Modeling of Enterprise Clusters Activities in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: An intelligent information technology (IT) for multi-agent modeling of enterprise clusters activities is proposed, the use of which in engineering education is due to the need to both gain knowledge in the field of management and master the procedures for system research of complex objects based on the application of a multi-agent approach and agent modeling. The proposed IT involves the implementation of four stages. At the first stage, a precedent diagram was developed reflecting the use cases of the system. At the second stage, state diagrams were developed for the main agents of the system: a cluster of manufacturing enterprises, a cluster of commercial enterprises and the Federal Tax Service. At the third stage, the system software was developed. The developed intelligent information technology and software of the modeling system makes it possible to support decision-making procedures in managing the activities of clusters of manufacturing and trading enterprises. Scenario research has been carried out using the developed intelligent system for modeling the activities of clusters of manufacturing and trading enterprises, taking into account the adjustment of tax rates. Research has shown the importance of improving tax policy both for the real sector of the economy and for the state. It has been revealed that decisions in the form of a reduction in the value added tax rate have a more significant impact on the activities of a cluster of manufacturing enterprises. Mastering the proposed technology by students of engineering universities in their practical and laboratory work, the application of this knowledge and skills in the performance of final qualifying works, along with the acquisition of other modern intelligent information technologies, will ensure an improvement in the quality of engineering education in general.

articleTitle: Mechanism for Managing the Development of University Teachers Digital Competencies in the Conditions of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: As part of the study, a model of an organizational mechanism for managing the development of digital competencies of teaching staff in the higher education system in the context of digital transformation was developed. The proposed mechanism includes a human resources management model for the purpose of developing digital competencies, a system for diagnosing the current and required level of development of digital competencies, a set of tools for the development of digital mobility and digital adaptation of human resources in higher education and can be adapted for any university. A feature of the proposed approach is the management of the development of digital competencies based on the PDCA method, taking into account the types of tasks facing the teacher. Tools have been developed to improve the efficiency of the management mechanism, in particular, an individual digital profile of a teacher and a matrix for selecting a tool for developing digital competence. Application of the proposed approach will make it possible to comprehensively increase the level of development of digital competencies of teachers by compiling an individual track for the development of digital competencies for each teacher.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Nanocomposite Materials with Distant Technologies and Electronic Resources for Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Due to the evolution of computer technologies and theoretical approaches, simulation methods have become one of the most reliable and cost-effective instruments for the educational process and materials science, allowing one to predict the properties of materials in advance and avoid the waste of resources. This article represents the special aspects of introduction of distant technologies and electronic resources into the design and teaching of the discipline “Computer simulation of nanocomposite materials” for Master’s degree chemical engineering students. This discipline is a part of Master’s degree program “Smart materials” and available online on the learning platform Moodle. It includes educational and methodological materials, various teaching and learning tools, checkpoints, interactive tasks, crosswords, tests, interactive whiteboards, etc. Specific teaching tools, simulation instruments and resources were selected for lectures, laboratory works and seminar classes, including in the case of distance learning format. Remote project tasks for distant learning require the use of electronic and Internet resources, databases and remote computing tools. Using modern software products, students learn how to select components for creating promising nanocomposite materials depending on their practical application. The study of the developed unique discipline will allow engineering students to master modern theoretical methods and techniques, which will help them in research activities and increase their competitive skills in the modern market of innovative materials and computing technologies.

articleTitle: Current Trends in the Global Information Technology Market in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The author considers the prerequisites and directions for the development of the global market for information technologies in higher education, analyze the impact of the changed geopolitical situation in Europe on the provision of Russian higher engineering education with modern information technologies. The purpose of the study is to determine current trends in the development of the Russian information technology market in engineering education. The object of the study is the direction of development of the global market of information technologies in engineering education, the subject of the study is the possibility of developing the Russian segment of the market of information technologies in engineering education in accordance with global trends. As the results of the study, the article presents the identified directions for the development of the Russian segment of the information technology market in engineering education: 1) the use of artificial intelligence technology (for example, ChatGPT), 2) the introduction of virtual reality technologies in engineering education, 3) gamification of the learning process, 4) using mobile devices for learning.

articleTitle: Intelligent Synthesis of Individual Rehabilitation Plans for Patients after Joint Endoprosthesis Based on Computer Vision Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article presents an innovative approach to the rehabilitation process for patients with joint endoprosthetics, focusing on the integration of a specialized software module based on computer vision technologies and the ontological approach. Developed for the Federal Centre for Traumatology, Orthopaedics, and Endoprosthesis in Smolensk, Russia, this system is designed to improve the quality of life for patients by offering personalized rehabilitation plans. The core of the study lies in the application of ontological models and meta-associative graphs for synthesizing individual rehabilitation plans, which streamline the recovery process and reduce the workload on healthcare professionals. This method allows for the processing of large amounts of information, providing detailed conclusions and recommendations for functional correction of the musculoskeletal system. The software utilizes computer vision to analyze patient movement and develop tailored rehabilitation strategies, overcoming the limitations of traditional diagnostic tools like MRI, which may not be suitable for all patients. By incorporating artificial intelligence and augmented reality, the system enhances the accuracy of patient assessments and the effectiveness of rehabilitation plans. Furthermore, the article discusses the application of this technology in the educational process at the Belarusian-Russian University, where students are introduced to cutting-edge software tools that assist in creating personalized rehabilitation plans. This educational integration not only enriches the students’ learning experience but also fosters innovation in the development of new applications for computer vision in medical rehabilitation. The ontological approach, combined with modern technology, represents a significant advancement in the management of musculoskeletal system diseases, offering a more efficient, personalized approach to rehabilitation and recovery.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining to Improve the University Electronic Educational Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The improvement of computer hardware and software, the accumulation of large amounts of data contributed to the development of the direction of data mining and related educational data mining. This article is devoted to the issues of educational data mining. The introduction describes the relevance of the issue. The main part consists of two sections. The first one is devoted to the concept of educational data mining, the reasons for its occurrence, goals and objectives. The second section describes methods of educational data mining and their practical application. A variant of their practical application for improving the MPEI electronic educational environment is also considered.

articleTitle: Methodology for Determining Professional Personality Traits of Future Engineers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the methodology for determining professional inclinations. The technique includes three stages. Each stage is aimed at a specific age group of students. The work is built on a partnership between people and machine learning, combining human-centered values aimed at creating a digital ecosystem within the framework of the Industry 5.0 concept. At the first stage, a model of a recommender system with the use of artificial intelligence is presented. The most significant areas of knowledge that the student needs to pay attention to in order to develop his inclinations and become an engineer with basic skills in the process of understanding the world and the required imagination are taken into account as well. The disciplinary model of individual professional orientation of a personality is given at the second stage, as well as a description of his/her evaluation scales. At the third stage, within the framework of a model of comprehensive career guidance for students, the physiological inclinations and abilities of an engineer’s personality are revealed. A definition of the professional potentials of an engineer’s personality is given on the basis of the results totality of the three stages. Based on the methodology discussed in the article, the Profvektorium software package was developed.

articleTitle: Assessment of Job Satisfaction of a University Teacher in the E-Learning System as a Tool for Managing the Development of Digital Competencies of Faculty Members
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Global trends in the digitalization of education have new demands on the digital skills of teachers and the development of digital mobility for rapid adaptation to digital technologies. The purpose of this study is to develop a methodology for assessing job satisfaction of a higher education teacher in the e-learning system to improve the efficiency of managing the development of digital competencies of teaching staff. To evaluate the work of a teacher in the e-learning system, an evaluation method has been developed, which includes assessing satisfaction with the teacher’s work in 5 areas: student satisfaction with the quality of the content of the e-course; student satisfaction with the quality of feedback given by the teacher; satisfaction of educational department employees; satisfaction of LMS technical support specialists; satisfaction of heads of educational departments/ the educational program directors regarding the work of teachers to achieve the goals of educational program. The testing of the methodology for assessing satisfaction with the work of a teacher in the electronic environment was carried out on the basis of the Institute of Remote and Additional Education of the Moscow Power Engineering Institute (MPEI) in JanuaryFebruary 2023. An assessment was made of satisfaction with the activities of 125 teachers in the context of 199 electronic courses, which were connected to 654 study groups. The particular value and practical significance of the methodology lies in the study of the teacher’s work in the digital environment from the side of internal stakeholders, on whose interaction the success of e-learning also depends. The developed methodology allows us to identify the weaknesses and strengths of teachers, which makes it possible to increase the efficiency of e-learning business processes. Testing of the methodology using the example of e-learning at Moscow Power Engineering Institute (MPEI) revealed the need to develop digital competencies such as communications in the digital environment, skills in visualizing digital materials and the use of interactive forms of learning.

Author Keywords: management of the development of digital competencies

articleTitle: Interactive Applications with Graphic User Interfaces for STEM Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to the support of STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, Mathematics) technologies in engineering education. It is shown that STEAM technologies are impossible without an environment for describing problem settings, tools for simple and fast building of graphical user interfaces, performing computational experiment, presentation and visualization of initial data, results and storytelling. Also, tools are needed for rapid web applications development, or interactive solution of inverse (design) problems, statistical modeling, virtual laboratories. A set of requirements for solving these problems is discussed. Python ecosystem technologies that can be used for their solution are considered, including JupyterLab, Jupyter Notebook, JupyterHub, Voila, voici, Reacton, Solara, Flet, Shiny, BeeWare, marimo, Mercury, Streamlit, Streamsync, Taipy, Reflex, Trame, PyVibe, Plotly Dash. The technologies are compared for compliance with the stated requirements. The selection of a technology chain to support STEAM in the engineering education is discussed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Algorithm of Locust Swarm and Spider Colony for Global Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Nature-inspired algorithms demonstrate great potential for solving complex search engine optimization problems in engineering calculations and design of large and small energy facilities, including renewable energy sources. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid algorithm that models the behavior patterns of a locust swarm and a spider colony to efficiently solve global optimization problems of multivariate multi-extremal functions. The modified locust swarm algorithm avoids concentration of individuals at the current best positions, reduces the probability of premature convergence, and maintains the intensification/diversification balance. The modified spider colony algorithm models two unique behavior patterns, allows diversification of the search space for the optimal solution, and acts as a filter to reduce the influence of very good or bad solutions on the search process. Hybridization of the modified algorithms is done by combining them sequentially (preprocessor/post-processor). We experimentally tested the algorithm on seven known multivariate functions. We compared the results with competing algorithms for particle swarm, differential evolution, and colony of bees. The proposed algorithm provides better results for all considered functions. Checking the statistical significance of the results obtained using the Wilcoxon rank sum test for independent samples showed that the algorithm results are statistically significant.

articleTitle: Prospects of Applying the LMS Moodle in Organizing Practical Classes on Modeling Heterogeneous Catalytic Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The analysis of various LMS-platforms of electronic distance education is carried out. The advantage of using the modular object-oriented environment Moodle for developing a distance learning course is demonstrated. Computer tests of input (pre-lecture quiz), intermediate (post-lecture quiz, homework assignments, problem sets) and final control (final test) of students’ progress in the discipline “Chemical kinetics and reactor design” are discussed. Examples of modeling heterogeneous catalytic processes of acetylene hydrogenation in the ethane-ethylene fraction of pyrogas, propane dehydrogenation to propylene, steam and oxidative methanol reforming to hydrogen over various nanocatalysts are considered.

articleTitle: 3D Modeling for a Flexible Detector in VR Radiography Simulator
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Digital simulators based on virtual reality expand the range of educational opportunities and improve the quality of learning in various areas of knowledge through deeper “immersion” in the learning process. Attention to the details of the modeled process plays an important role. One of the tasks of interactive simulators is to provide an opportunity to see the relationship between the user’s actions and the obtained qualitative and quantitative parameters and quality attributes of the simulated process result. Considered the issue of curved shape detectors application relevance in the practice of penetrating radiation evaluation in general and in industrial radiography in particular. The prerequisites for the creation of flexible (bendable) form of digital radiographic detectors and the features of two generations of practically implemented devices are analyzed. Development of a flexible detector digital twin is considered, models and algorithms for its realization in a virtual reality environment are proposed, and the main results of computational and laboratory experiments as well as the obtained radiographic images are presented. The main task of virtual reality technologies within the qualified technical specialists training programs is the development of their professional skills and the formation of stable behavior patterns that ensure strict compliance with the rules and requirements of industrial safety, thereby ensuring the high quality of the end product.

articleTitle: Results of Educational Program Implementation "Project Activities in Space Technologies"
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Currently project activities are widely implemented, but among all programs, special attention is paid to engineering education. This is due to the need to train young specialists who will be able to solve complex and non-standard tasks. It should be noted that the implementation of project activities takes place both at the level of higher and secondary education. To solve this problem, teachers with practical experience are involved, who have mastered all the complexities of project activities. The implementation process takes place in various ways: from setting individual or group tasks in the program of a subject or discipline to allocating certain time and premises for project work. However, the purpose of this implementation remains unchanged, regardless of the form or level of education: training the younger generation to be ready not only to do standard work, but also to develop and produce really working products and services in demand. This article discusses the process of developing and implementing the discipline “Design activities in space technologies”. The progress of the work and the results obtained in 2022-2024 are described. The program is designed for one semester and can be implemented both in full-time and distance format.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Technologies in Education – Evolution or Revolution?
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: With the development of technology, the education systems of various countries are undergoing certain changes aimed at an increasingly wider range of students. Printing, which arose in the XV century, made it possible, in a relatively short time, to collect and preserve a significant amount of knowledge acquired by humanity over the past period. Since this time, education systems have begun to become an increasingly important part of society and increasingly influence its development. The exchange of knowledge between schools and universities in different countries is expanding. Teaching methods are being developed at various levels, educational and methodological materials are being created, a logically sound training system is being built, starting from teaching children and then adults, including with the aim of improving their qualifications and retraining. Certain standards are being developed and implemented to establish consistency between the education systems of different countries. Various enterprises and organizations are becoming increasingly involved in the educational process, since they are the ones interested in training relevant specialists who enter the labor market after completing their studies. Considering the increasing speed of change in the workers needed by enterprises with new competencies, enterprises themselves become organizers of a system of advanced training and retraining, thereby complementing existing education systems in the form of various colleges, institutes, and universities.This article examines the processes occurring in the education system with the expanding use of distance technologies and a variety of electronic educational and methodological resources, including artificial intelligence systems. The experience of various Russian and foreign educational institutions is considered, taking into account different requirements for the educational process, systems for assessing the quality of education, the demand for graduates, and the attitude of students themselves to the new technological solutions used.

articleTitle: Tensile Properties Estimation of 3D Printed Polylactic Acid Samples via Process Parameters using Data-Driven Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The main purpose of this article is to investigate the static properties, e.g., ultimate tensile strength and elastic modulus, of polylactic acid samples that are made by 3D printing method. To this end, laboratory results of tensile tests were collected for different manufacturing parameters. Furthermore, various data-driven methods were used to model and predict more states. The mathematical equations for calculating each of the static properties of the material in terms of 3D printing parameters was provided using regression technique. Moreover, the results of Taguchi sensitivity analysis showed that Infill density is the most effective parameter on all tensile properties of the investigated material. Finally, the response surface method was utilized to determine the interaction of 3D printing process parameters simultaneously on the static properties of the samples.

articleTitle: Educational Design of Dynamic Intelligent System Prototypes Using Tutoring Integrated Expert Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Using a new kind of web-based tutoring integrated expert system (web-IES), developed on the basis of a problem-oriented methodology and the intelligent software environment of the AT-TECHNOLOGY workbench, and operating under the control of the generalized ontology “Intelligent Systems and Technologies” (direction of training “Software Engineering") at the Department of Cybernetics of National Research Nuclear University MEPhI, the capabilities of the educational process automated support associated with the practical training of specialists in the field of designing dynamic intelligent systems are examined. The theoretical and methodological foundation of the instructional web-based IES is the proven and tested technology for dynamic IES prototype based on the integration of methods and means of presenting and processing temporal information with methods and means of simulation modeling. The basic components of the training web-based IES (trainer model, training model) are examined, and examples are given, with a particular focus on a new strategy for implementing the training impact of the “Training with ES/IES” type for identifying and sharing the skills of trainees to solve design problems related to the construction of dynamic intelligent systems.

articleTitle: Ensemble ARIMA-LSTM Algorithm in Predicting Agriculture Commodities Market Price for Farmer’s Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Agriculture is crucial as the backbone of national economy and source of food for human. To be adapted with Industry 4.0, farmers should possessed the knowledge on price prediction of the agriculture crops and commodities so that they can make better farming decision according to supply and demand. In this paper, we analysed the agriculture commodities market price data of three categories namely fruit, poultry and vegetable. Six commodities of berangan banana, chicken, choy sum, green chilli, highlands tomato and standard chicken were chosen for analysis based on their data availability and most commonly used in Malaysian dishes. It was observed that the vegetable category is the most volatile in terms of price fluctuations. Green chilli had the highest variation while berangan banana showed the least. Three artificial intelligence based algorithms namely Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and ensemble ARIMA-LSTM algorithms were employed for price prediction using 12 datasets with a total of 7235 daily price data at retail level. The results show that ensemble ARIMA-LSTM performed better in predicting most of the commodities as determined by RMSE values. The proposed algorithm should be versatile in predicting market price at any demographic, in any country in the world.

articleTitle: Batch Workflow Scheduling Optimization in Cloud Resource Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The constantly evolving cloud ecosystems are promising environments for the execution of science-intensive applications within the framework of the new concept of Workflow-as-a-Service (WaaS). WaaS platforms, being the so-called multitenant environments, provide efficient mechanisms for managing continuous and heterogeneous job-flows in cloud computing. However, in this scenario, along with the complexity of scheduling composite workflows, an additional problem arises to efficiently manage the cloud resources, that is, to determine the start and shutdown times of virtual resources, considering the available economic policy. To handle this problem, we propose a modification to the critical jobs method which has been the basis of the Systems Design course in the Department of Computing Technologies for over 15 years. The resulting solution combines several heuristics to optimize the cloud resource management for WaaS platforms and largely determined the successful completion of RSF project. Some experiments with the real-world workflows prove the optimization efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Multi-Criteria Assessment of Students Performance Integrating AHP, Entropy and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In recent years, the active implementation of internet facilitated the on-line forms of education at all levels. However, the experience during the COVID pandemics raised some concerns about virtual environment’s impact on the results at the different stages of the education process. In this situation, it is necessary to adapt the monitoring and analysis of the acquisition of targeted knowledge and skills. This paper employs multi-criteria approach to explore students’ performance based on the combination Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the objective data treatment with classical entropy with a recently developed approach based on hierarchy of information. The final evaluation is based on the „Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS)“.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Controlling an Autonomous Vehicle for Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article presents a highly autonomous vehicle (HAV) control algorithm for agriculture. Using HAV in agriculture can reduce costs and the impact of chemicals on machine operators and increase labor productivity. Article describes the approach and technical aids for converting existing vehicles into HAV. Article discusses the considered proposed architecture of the HAV control subsystem. An example used in the article is the UAZ Patriot car. Proposed approach is portable to various types of vehicles. The article also presents an algorithm for generating the optimal trajectory of the HAV movement across the field, considering its boundaries and static obstacles. Proposed algorithm is based on reinforcement learning. The resulting trajectory gets loaded into the HAV control subsystem. Algorithm for modifying the trajectory of the HAV movement based on Reeds-Shepp curves is used to avoid dynamic obstacles. This algorithm allows to change the trajectory of the HAV to avoid dynamic obstacles and return to the original route. The YOLOv8 model processes the data from technical vision tools for object detection. Authors developed a simulator based on the Robot Operating System library to reduce costs and increase the speed of developing and debugging the HAV control algorithms. The framework of the research work considered the involvement of students from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and the Faculty of Information Systems and Technologies at the Ulyanovsk State Technical University.

articleTitle: What the Heck is STEM in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the application of STEM technologies in the educational process on the example of the discipline “Scientific, Technical and Engineering Calculations”. The main applied pedagogical approaches, examples of solved problems, requirements to educational materials are analyzed. It is shown that storytelling, solving a large number of interesting, understandable to students’ problems, scientific visualization, statistical modeling and solving inverse problems (design problems) give the maximum effect, allow to keep students’ attention and interest. The questions of reducing the labor intensity of the educational process are discussed in detail. It is shown that the necessary condition for students to absorb the educational material is the preliminary publication of video recordings of lectures, practical classes, source code of solved problems, reference information and interactive web-applications for homework and mini-projects.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-agent Technologies for Transforming Network Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article substantiates the possibilities of implementing network programs of higher and additional professional education based on multi-agent technologies that transform all basic educational processes, ensuring their flexibility and adaptability to the dynamic needs of the labor market. The use of multi-agent technologies for engineering education, which is characterized by the use of complex and high-cost software, hardware and engineering systems that require the organization of collective sharing of resources, is becoming especially relevant. For multi-agent technologies, a method is chosen for representing agents in the form of asset administrative shells of fourth-generation industry systems, representing digital twins of information, educational, software, technical and organizational-methodological resources. The article proposes the structure of a multi-agent networked learning system; requirements for information representation of educational processes and the composition of key services in the asset administrative shells are defined. It introduces a multi-agent technology for the interaction of participants in the creation of networked educational programs. The software implementation of a multi-agent networked learning system based on the FIPA (Foundation for Intelligent Physical Agents) standards and the specifications of the asset administrative shells of the Platform Industry 4.0 project will enhance the adaptability of networked educational programs. This will be achieved through the individualization of the learning process, with the real-time involvement of resources from various educational institutions and the collective use of software, technical, and engineering complexes. The collection of big data on the execution of educational processes in the asset administrative shells will contribute to both the real-time adjustment of the multi-agent system to the evolving competency model of learners and the improvement of the educational content throughout the entire system. The research results presented in the article will be applicable in teaching the courses “Design of Intelligent Information Systems” (bachelor’s degree) and “Knowledge Engineering” (master’s degree) in the field of study “Applied Informatics.”

articleTitle: Dynamic Abilities of Cooperative Formations as a Basis for Balanced Sustainable Development of their Participants in Strategic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Modern industrial and economic entities and the totality of their connections are gradually transforming into ecosystem forms of interaction, which collective network competencies give them the ability to continuously update. One of the ways to achieve sustainable growth in the strategic perspective is the priority of transforming industrial and socioeconomic processes based on innovation. Attempts to develop individual participants and supporting elements of such complex systems autonomously, point-by-point, without taking into account coordinating and balancing the interests, capabilities and limitations of each of them slow down the achievement of the strategic orientations of individual participants, the priorities of the association and negatively affect their sustainability. Based on the analysis of approaches and tools to ensure the profitability of innovative activities and long-term sustainable competitive advantages in accordance with modern concepts of the category of resources and ecosystem approach, as well as the changing role of human capital in ensuring production and economic activity, the role and place of dynamic abilities in the context of complex socioeconomic and industrial systems modernization are determined in the article, need for coherence and balance in development of their participants in the aspect of providing industrial enterprises with one of the critically important resources – human resources, for the sustainable development of both themselves and the benefits of other participants and the system as a whole in a strategic perspective is determined. The article highlights the key provisions of the concept of “Industry 4.0” and focuses on the importance of human interaction and technology, openness of information and intellectualization of algorithms. Digital technologies have significantly accelerated all structural changes in recent years and cover an increasing number of subjects, phenomena and processes. There is also a decrease in the predictability of these changes and an increase in the “price of error”, which determines the urgent need to choose approaches and, based on them, form methodological and practical management tools for modern industrial and economic entities that not only take these changes into account “at the moment”, but are also able to adaptively and flexibly restructure, while maintaining a strategic focus on the mission, focusing on the basic general rules and targets. The characteristics of dynamic abilities and key competencies concepts in relation to a cooperative group are also presented. They should be the basis for the transformation of engineering education in response to the challenges faced by modern industrial enterprises.

articleTitle: Low-Data Welding Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The study delves into the analysis of binary image classification techniques tailored for detecting defects within welded seams amidst constraints posed by limited data availability. Extensive scrutiny was conducted on methodologies, including augmentation, hard-mining, Transfer Learning, and Few-shot Learning, dissecting their efficacy within scenarios of restricted training data. Findings from this rigorous analysis served as the cornerstone for the formulation of a model training method dubbed ‘task switch.’ This innovative approach showcases notable advancements in object classification accuracy, particularly evident when dealing with modest data volumes. Such enhancements stem from the unique characteristics exhibited by the selected models’ receptive fields subsequent to the transition to detection. The ‘task switch’ methodology demonstrates a remarkable ability to harness these attributes, leading to a substantial surge in the precision of defect identification within binary image classifications. The amalgamation of task switch and refined detection mechanisms establishes a paradigm shift, significantly amplifying the accuracy of defect detection in welded seams despite constrained data availability. The study also underscores the significance of adaptability in model architecture, showcasing the task switch’s capacity to dynamically adjust to varying data constraints, solidifying its position as a pioneering framework in addressing the challenges of limited data in defect detection within welded seams.

articleTitle: An Object-oriented Approach to Ontological Engineering of Complex Cyber-physical systems Based on Meta-associative Graphs
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article delves into the pivotal role of cyberphysical systems in the fabric of modern digital and automated environments, serving as a cornerstone of the Industrial Internet of Things and the Industry 4.0 revolution. These systems represent a synthesis of computational algorithms and physical processes, resulting in intelligent, autonomous systems equipped for self-correction and adaptation. The ability of cyber-physical systems to monitor environmental changes, adapt to the physical world, and manage complex tasks marks a significant leap in automating production and ensuring safety in intelligent transportation, among other applications. At the heart of developing and deploying cyber-physical systems is the ontological approach, which employs structured frameworks to delineate the interactions between cyber and physical elements. Ontologies, by categorizing and organizing knowledge, are vital for modeling relationships within cyber-physical systems, enhancing interoperability and communication across various domains. The quasi-hierarchical structure of cyber-physical systems ontologies, where a child node may link to multiple parents, introduces a nuanced representation of complex system interdependencies, surpassing the capabilities of traditional hierarchical models. Ontological engineering for cyber-physical systems merges object-oriented and structural analysis methodologies, focusing on key entity classes and their interrelations to dictate system evolution and behavior. The object-oriented approach divides into structuring data and knowledge, organizing system data, and developing user interfaces that support cyber-physical systems business processes, culminating in a coherent, functional system model. The article posits meta-associative graphs as a superior ontological engineering tool for cyber-physical systems compared to the Web Ontology Language (OWL) and frames, particularly due to their flexibility in representing quasi-hierarchical structures and dynamic relationships. An ontological framework enables developers to create a software instrumental environment where domain experts can independently construct ontologies and business processes, bridging the semantic gap between experts and developers.

articleTitle: Using the Moodle Platform in Teaching Business - Letter Writing to Students at English Classes
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper considers the possibilities of using the Moodle learning management system when studying English at university. The peculiarities of teaching students a foreign language in a non-language university and the possibilities of increasing the effectiveness of learning by using distance (electronic) learning in comparison with the face-to-face format of similar labor intensity are noted. Written skills and abilities in the use of a foreign language are one of the important aspects of communicative competence. They are necessary for practical mastery of everyday speech and the language of specialty. The possibilities of learning management systems and distance learning facilitate the work of the teacher. The developed special interactive exercises are aimed at accelerated formation of students’ written skills as part of their foreign language communicative competence.

articleTitle: Web Resource for Teaching the Basics of Relational Databases
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article presents an educational web resource developed by teachers and students of Vologda State University. It is used to teach IT students the skills of developing queries to a relational database and writing program code stored in the database. As main part of the web resource, there is an extensive bank of training tasks designed for independent solution by students, and a system for automatic checking students’ solutions. To justify the necessity of resource development, the article presents an analytical review of existing online database training resources. Structural and algorithmic decisions accepted at realization of automatic checking of students’ solutions in the developed resource are considered. The bank of training tasks on the course “Databases” is briefly presented. The experience of using the web resource in the educational process for effective organization of students’ independent work is analyzed.

articleTitle: Software Applications for Selecting and Calculating the Reliability of Technological Equipment for Training Chemical Technologists
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Modern software systems developed for the selection of pipeline fittings on main oil and product pipelines, as well as for calculating and assessing the reliability of process equipment, are considered. The need to develop software applications for the selection of pipeline fittings, calculation of reliability indicators and assessment of the reliability of parts, elements and all technological equipment as a whole is substantiated. A mathematical formulation of the problem is given. The algorithm of operation of software applications and examples of the use of software in the educational process are described. The programs have shown that their use significantly speeds up the process of mastering topics and increases the activity and motivation of students.

articleTitle: Computational Model of Swarm Algorithm for Optimizing Process of Keywords Extraction from Text Information Presented as Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes the scientific problem of optimizing the processes of acquiring knowledge when processing textual information presented in the form of a graph, based on the development of a modified bioinspired algorithm for extracting keywords. The solution proposed by the authors differs from the known ones by introducing new attractive operators and behavioral patterns of bacterial agents into the computational model of the bacterial swarm algorithm. This approach allows you to balance the ratio of the speed of convergence of the algorithm with the diversification of the search space for solutions. The article also presents an analytical study of the features of two types of parsing: constituency parsing and dependency parsing. As part of the study, algorithms for syntactic parsing of dependencies between elements of text information and a graph-based dependency parsing algorithm are described. The formulation of the problem of keyword extraction is given. The task of achieving a balance between accuracy and speed of a linguistic parser is an open topic that requires further research due to the importance of this problem for improving the efficiency of text analysis, especially in applications that require real-time accuracy. To increase the efficiency of solving the problem, the authors propose a modified bioinspired algorithm for extracting keywords. The computational experiment carried out allows us to conclude that the modified bacterial optimization method proposed by the authors is in a leading position, which confirms the need to continue research into the applicability of bioinspired methods for solving problems of acquiring knowledge when processing text information presented in the form of a graph. This article is focused on the direction of study in the master’s program “Informatics and Computer Science”, as well as the scientific specialty of postgraduate training “Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning”.

articleTitle: Control of the Acoustic Field of a Pressurized Water Reactor
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Improving the safety and operational efficiency of nuclear power plants (NPPs) remains a pressing issue. This paper presents comprehensive digital acoustical models (DAMs) for pressurizer system (PS) of the VVER nuclear reactors. It is shown that the ASW of PS DAMPS field contains ASW created by the reactor, steam generators (SG) and main circulation pumps (MCP), which are external vibration-inducing forces that have a powerful effect on the entire primary circuit. Vibration sensors are installed on the reactor vessel, SG, MCP, pipelines. High-quality processing of pressure pulsation sensors’ signals (PPS) installed in the hot and cold legs of the primary circuit provides high correlation with vibrations at ASW frequencies. The IT applied for creating DAMPS uses an inter-disciplinary methodology. It is shown that DAMPS is a system of self-oscillation that generates ASWs that are adequate to the acoustic field of multiple synchronously working Helmholtz resonators, providing control for the primary circuit acoustic field by damping ASW that cause an unacceptable level of equipment vibration. DAMPS has been introduced into the educational process. The creation of IT solutions for engineering education based on domestic solutions is critically important, as it ensures not only import substitution, but also advances in the creation of advanced technologies.
